tool_config.name: take_message
tool_config.description: Leaves a message for the practice, who will call back. Use when the caller asks for a person, asks something you can't answer, when a tool says handoff, or when you are unsure what they want.

Authorization.secret_id: <SECRET_ID: Hourhand tool key for this host>

language.description: The language the caller is speaking: en or hi.

phone.description: A number to call back on, with country code. Empty to use the number they are calling from.

message.description: What the caller wants, in their words, in one to three sentences.

reason.description: Why you are taking a message.
